extraction.summary_en: Procès-verbal of the 20 October 2006 Extraordinary General Assembly of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES, a SAS. The assembly decided to increase capital by 50,000 euros (from 150,000€ to 200,000€) by creating 500 new actions of 100€ nominal, to be paid through compensation with debts. The 500 new actions were reserved for three named subscribers: Xavier AUMONT (330), Antonio BLANCO MARINA (150), and Franck GICQUEL (20). The assembly also approved a new shareholder, Michel CAPGRAS, and authorized Xavier AUMONT to transfer 225 actions to him. Updated statutes reflecting the new 200,000€ capital are included.

events.date_basis: Date of the AGM at which the increase was decided and immediately adopted unanimously; the updated statutes dated 20 October 2006 show the new capital of 200,000€ in effect.
events.mechanism: compensation de comptes courants (offset against debts/current accounts)

evidence.quote_fr: d'augmenter le capital social d'une somme de 50.000 euros, pour le porter de 150.000 euros à 200.000 euros, par création de 500 actions nouvelles de 100 euros de valeur nominale chacune, émises au pair, à libérer en totalité lors de la souscription, par compensation avec des créances certaines, liquides et exigibles sur la Société.

events.gloss_en: Capital increased by 50,000€ from 150,000€ to 200,000€ by creating 500 actions of 100€ nominal, paid by offset against shareholder debts.

events.date_basis: Date of the AGM of 17 May 2005 that decided the previous capital increase.

evidence.quote_fr: L'assemblée générale extraordinaire du 17/05/2005 a ensuite décidé d'augmenter ce capital à 150.000 euros.

events.gloss_en: Earlier capital increase from 37,000€ to 150,000€ decided by AGM of 17 May 2005 (restated in updated statutes).

evidence.quote_fr: L'Assemblée Générale, après avoir pris connaissance du rapport du Président agrée à devenir actionnaire Monsieur Michel CAPGRAS, né te 16 juillet 1956, demeurant 161 rue Jean-Jacques Rousseau à Montauban (82ooo), célibataire, de nationalité Française.

events.gloss_en: Michel CAPGRAS approved as a new shareholder (agrément) and authorized to receive 225 actions via transfer from Xavier AUMONT.

events.date_basis: Date of AGM at which the transfer was authorized.

evidence.quote_fr: L'Assemblée Générale autorise Monsieur Xavier AUMONt à céder 225 actions à Monsieur Michel CAPGRAs. Ce faisant, chaque actionnaire renonce individuellement à son droit de préemption.

events.gloss_en: Xavier AUMONT authorized to transfer 225 actions to Michel CAPGRAS; each shareholder renounces their preemption right.

snapshots.as_of_basis: Feuille de présence (attendance sheet) signed at the AGM held on 20 October 2006, before the capital increase and share transfer decisions took effect.

evidence.quote_fr: Certifiée sincère et véritable la présente feuille de présence, arrêtée à 3 associés présents ou représentés possédant ensemble 1500 actions. Monsieur Antonio BLANCO 803 803 ... Monsieur Xavier AUMONT 637 637 ... Monsieur Franck GICQUEL 60 60

snapshots.as_of_basis: Updated statutes signed on 20 October 2006 after the capital increase was decided and the share transfer was authorized, showing the final capital structure.

evidence.quote_fr: Le capital social est fixé à la somme de deux cent mille (200.000) euros. Il est divisé en deux mille (2000) actions d'une seule catégorie de cent (100) euros de nominal chacune, libérées en totalité.

issues: OCR errors in personal details (e.g., 'AuMoNT' and 'AuMont' for AUMONT, 'CAPGRAs' for CAPGRAS); corrected in output.
Resolution 5 (employee share plan) was rejected unanimously (p4.23), so no capital increase for employees was approved.

The operating date of the capital increase (30 June 2006 vs. 20 October 2006): Resolution 2 was conditional on approval in the third resolution and set a deadline of 16 November 2006 for subscribers to exercise their subscription rights; the statutes dated 20 October 2006 show the capital already at 200,000€, suggesting the increase was completed by that date.
